claim: Source and documentation review of datalab-to/marker at commit 8a1d2344de25d7ec4c5209133aed7af565874ff0 (license Apache-2.0), read from README.md at that commit. Repository description: "Convert PDF to markdown + JSON quickly with high accuracy". Reviewer summary of the upstream documentation: Datalab's open-source pipeline converting PDFs, images, DOCX/PPTX/XLSX, HTML and EPUB to Markdown/JSON/chunks, using its own Surya OCR/layout/table/equation models on GPU, CPU or MPS, with an optional LLM-refinement pass. Requirement part it addresses (document-retrieval): Directly produces 'source-grounded Markdown/document content' through 'controlled ingestion' of PDFs/Office/HTML: per its own README it reads the PDF text layer and OCRs selectively, so extracted text stays grounded in the original page content and reading order, including tables/equations/multi-column layout.

documentation_excerpts.text: Marker converts documents to markdown, JSON, chunks, and HTML quickly and accurately.
If you have high volume workloads, we offer a batch processing service that has processed 1B+ pages per week — we manage the infrastructure so your workloads finish on time.

limitations: Source and documentation review at the pinned commit only: not installed, executed, benchmarked or compared with any other component.

The description and excerpts are the upstream project's own words at that commit; the reviewer summary was written by a research agent and checked by an independent fit review. Both are upstream claims, not measured results.
